name: Evacuation
winCondition: After end-of-game bonuses/penalties, a player with all 3 New World production markers at 8+ and 3 stadiums on the New World wins (several: most happy faces, tied share). If nobody qualifies, best lowest production marker wins; ties: 3+ New World stadiums, then happy faces, then second and third lowest markers.

endCondition.description: A player has all 3 production markers at 8+ and 3 stadiums on the New World (game ends after that phase), or at the end of year 4.

categories.label: Lowest production marker (after adjustments)
categories.labelVi: Marker sản xuất thấp nhất (sau điều chỉnh)
categories.hint: Apply -1 per penalty chip, -1 per unevacuated Old World site, -1 per missing stadium; then +2 most happy faces (+1 in 2p) / +1 second.

categories.label: Stadiums on the New World
categories.labelVi: Sân vận động ở Tân Thế Giới
categories.hint: Count only those on the New World.

categories.label: Meets win condition after adjustments
categories.hint: All 3 markers at 8+ and 3 stadiums on New World.

tiebreakers.description: Most happy faces (if several players meet the win condition; tied share victory)
If nobody meets it: best lowest production marker, then stadiums >= 3, happy faces, second then third lowest markers

notes: family: objective-race. Race Mode is the recommended mode. Points Mode is modelled in evacuation--points. Generous bonus variant and Advanced Action variant not modelled.

sources.title: Evacuation Rulebook (Delicious Games)
sources.section: End of Game (Race Mode) p.13-15; Points Mode p.16-18
